description: This file contains a class 'writeexcel_formula' that provides functionality for parsing Excel formulas into reverse Polish notation (RPN) byte code, including support for external references, ranges, functions, and operators. It is a component used in exporting or writing Excel files with formulas.

classes.name: writeexcel_formula
classes.description: A class that parses Excel formulas into reverse Polish notation (RPN) byte code for use in writing or exporting Excel files with formulas.

methods.name: writeexcel_formula
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formula parser with byte order setting.

methods.name: _init_parser
methods.description: Initializes internal hashes and data structures for parsing.

methods.name: parse_formula
methods.description: Parses a formula string into RPN encoded byte string.

methods.name: set_ext_sheet
methods.description: Sets an external sheet reference in the parser.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the provided data represents an error object.

methods.name: _initializeHashes
methods.description: Initializes internal mappings for PTG (Parse Token Group) and function hashes used for parsing formulas.

methods.name: _convert
methods.description: Converts a token to its PTG byte representation.

methods.name: _convertNumber
methods.description: Converts a numeric token to its PTG representation.

methods.name: _convertString
methods.description: Converts a string token to its PTG representation.

methods.name: _convertFunction
methods.description: Converts a function name and argument count to its PTG representation.

methods.name: _convertRange2d
methods.description: Converts a 2D range like A1:B2 to PTG.

methods.name: _convertRange3d
methods.description: Converts a 3D range like Sheet1!A1:D4 to PTG.

methods.name: _convertRef2d
methods.description: Converts a 2D cell reference like A1 to PTG.

methods.name: _convertRef3d
methods.description: Converts a 3D cell reference like Sheet1!A1 to PTG.

methods.name: _packExtRef
methods.description: Packs external sheet references into a binary structure.

methods.name: _getSheetIndex
methods.description: Retrieves index of a sheet by name.

methods.name: setExtSheet
methods.description: Updates external sheets hash for referencing.

methods.name: _cellToPackedRowcol
methods.description: Converts a cell reference to packed row and column bytes.

methods.name: _rangeToPackedRange
methods.description: Converts a range like A1:B2 into packed binary form.

methods.name: _cellToRowcol
methods.description: Converts an Excel cell reference into zero-based row and column indices with relative flags.

methods.name: _advance
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next token in the formula string.

methods.name: _match
methods.description: Checks if a token matches known operators, references, functions, or patterns.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a formula string and builds a parse tree.

methods.name: _condition
methods.description: Parses comparison conditions (e.g., >, <, =).

methods.name: _expression
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction expressions.

methods.name: _parenthesizedExpression
methods.description: Parses expressions within parentheses.

methods.name: _term
methods.description: Parses multiplication/division terms.

methods.name: _fact
methods.description: Parses factors: references, ranges, numbers, functions, parentheses.

methods.name: _func
methods.description: Parses function calls.

methods.name: _createTree
methods.description: Creates a syntax tree node with children.

methods.name: toReversePolish
methods.description: Converts the parse tree into RPN bytecode string.
